sentences.text:
----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Rekha Meena W/o Om Prakash, Kacchi Basti, Nimbahera,
 Chittorgarh.
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. J.K. Haniya For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukesh Trivedi, PP  Mr. Ashok Kumar, for respondent No.2  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 19/09/2023
The present bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.275/2023 Police Station Kotwali, District Chittorgarh for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2) of IPC and Sections 5(K), 6 of POCSO Act.

Counsel for the petitioner submits that the FIR in this case has been lodged after a considerable delay and according to the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C in which she clearly admits that there is friendship between them and if anything happened then it was with the consent of the prosecutrix.

Counsel further submits that the compromise has arrived between the parties and challan of the chase has already [2023:RJ-JD:30450] (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-8576/2023] been presented.
The accused-petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused- petitioner.

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposed the bail application.
Counsel for the respondent No.2 concurs the fact of compromise.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Sonu @ Gaurav S/o Ramesh Chand Khangar, shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.275/2023 of Police Station Kotwali, District Chittorgarh provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sound and solvent surety of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 70-Ishan/-
